newsitem.title: USA: U.S. power output rises 5.4 pct vs. year ago - EEI.
newsitem.headline: U.S. power output rises 5.4 pct vs. year ago - EEI.

text.p: Electricity deliveries in the continental U.S. totaled 67,649 gigawatt hours (GWh) for the week ended September 14, up 5.4 percent from the same period in 1995, the Edison Electric Institute (EEI) said Tuesday.
The amount of power supplied to New England and the Mid-Atlantic rose the most, with air conditioning demand rising from muggy weather in the regions during the week.
EEI said the Mid-Atlantic region showed the biggest increase over the same week last year, rising 11.8 percent from 1995 to 8,804 MWh.
Year-to-date domestic power production totalled about 3.29 million GWh, up 2.9 percent from the same period in 1995, EEI said.
